concepts.definition: F16, Engagement baseline, is an operational profile. Its foundation-to-law table traces premises, consequences, owning rules, added choices and pillars; it is not itself an additional rule. The profile owns its additions, not imported law, and states no axiomatic-calculus rule.

grounding.quote:
This member is material family F16, Engagement baseline (operational
profile).

this profile states no rule of the
a_c calculus and binds none.

concepts.label: Engagement baseline

concepts.definition: A frame whose evaluation family concerns selecting, constructing, assessing or disposing governed work. Executive, Worker and Reviewer are this profile's engagement frames.

grounding.quote:
An engagement frame is a frame (REFERENCE_FRAME §1) whose evaluation family
concerns selecting, constructing, assessing or disposing governed work.
Executive, Worker and Reviewer are this profile's engagement frames

concepts.label: Engagement frame

conditions: Needed by one engagement evaluation and activated.
concepts.definition: A Product, requirement, design, identity, release, domain, implementation, test, operational, historical or capability frame used by an engagement evaluation.

grounding.quote:
A specialist frame is an activated Product, requirement, design, identity,
release, domain, implementation, test, operational, historical or
capability frame that one engagement evaluation needs.

concepts.label: Specialist frame

concepts.definition: A reusable evaluation-family archetype naming a recurring distinction. A project instantiates it where material, obtains a capable authority's determination of non-materiality for the exact outcome, or retains explicit coverage residuals. An archetype does not select a carrier, component, actor, architecture, owner or implementation.

grounding.quote:
A generic specialist-frame family is a reusable evaluation-family archetype
of this profile (§11). It names a recurring distinction that a project
either instantiates where material, has capable authority establish as
non-material for the governed outcome, or keeps as an explicit coverage
residual

concepts.label: Generic specialist-frame family

concepts.definition: Testing frame, authoritative Product path and material combinatorial complexity are tier-2 terms owned and defined by ASSURANCE §7. This profile imports those meanings without additions.

grounding.quote:
Testing frame, authoritative Product path and material combinatorial
complexity are tier-2 terms defined in ASSURANCE §7. This profile uses them
as defined there and adds nothing to them

concepts.label: ASSURANCE-owned terms

concepts.definition: The engagement frame selecting or confirming bounded activation configuration and consuming closed Worker and Reviewer results under existing project decision authority. It holds the complete Product view and current MVP or release mandate needed for priority, disposition and selection of the next authorised action; this is not possession of the whole workspace.

grounding.quote:
Executive is this profile's label for the frame that selects or confirms
the bounded activation configuration and consumes closed Worker and
Reviewer results under existing project decision authority.

concepts.label: Executive

conditions: Activated as a frame under the governing work relation.
concepts.definition: The constructor role of ACTIVATION §1, owning bounded construction and self-review within its exact intake through inherited operation authority. Writer is its specialisation for documents and records.

grounding.quote:
Worker is this profile's label for the constructor role of ACTIVATION §1
activated as a frame. It owns construction and self-review inside its exact
intake, through the operation authority inherited from the governing work
relation.

It allocates construction to the Worker frame, specialised as Writer for
documents and records

concepts.label: Worker / Writer

conditions: Separately activated for the required independent assessment.
concepts.definition: An independent live-surface evaluation frame consumed by the assessment relation of ACTIVATION §1 and governed by EVALUATION independence, traceability, assurance-boundary and qualification-freeze law. It evaluates one exact subject and returns a closed evaluation with evidence-bound technical triage when findings exist.

grounding.quote:
Reviewer is this profile's label for the independent live-surface
evaluation that the assessment relation of ACTIVATION §1 consumes, governed
by EVALUATION §3 (independence and traceability) and EVALUATION §1 and §7
(assurance boundary and qualification freeze), activated as a frame. It
evaluates one exact subject and returns a closed result, with evidence-bound
technical triage when a finding exists.

concepts.label: Reviewer

concepts.definition: A Reviewer's assessment of one finding against the exact evaluated claim and basis. Its supportable payload comprises affected claim, observed failure, severity, causal assessment and confidence, blast radius, affected users/paths/relations, available workaround or containment, repair complexity, regression risk, material dependencies, residual uncertainty and evidence that would reduce uncertainty. Confidence is a quantified assurance claim.

grounding.quote:
Technical triage is the Reviewer's assessment of one finding against the
exact evaluated claim and basis. Where admissible evidence and the actor's
capability envelope support it, the triage records

concepts.label: Technical triage

concepts.definition: Severity is the Reviewer's grade of consequence if a finding manifests. Priority is the Executive's ordering of response against complete Product outcome, likelihood, exposure, current MVP/release mandate, reversibility, dependencies, cost of delay and available capacity. They remain distinct from each other, frame results and current-boundary effect.

grounding.quote:
Severity grades the consequence if the finding manifests. Priority orders
the response relative to the complete Product outcome, likelihood and
exposure, the current MVP or release mandate, reversibility, dependencies,
cost of delay and available capacity. The Reviewer grades severity; the
Executive assigns priority

concepts.label: Severity and priority

concepts.definition: The Executive's recorded determination that a finding blocks the current promotion boundary, requires narrowing it, or may remain an explicit residual. This is a decision projection with no core value of its own, not a frame result or disposition, and it decides nothing by itself.

grounding.quote:
Current-boundary effect is the Executive's recorded determination of what
one finding does to the current promotion boundary: it blocks it, requires
narrowing it, or may remain an explicit residual. It is a decision
projection, a state this profile declares, not a result and not a
disposition (§8): it maps to no core value of its own and decides nothing
by itself.

concepts.label: Current-boundary effect

conditions: Exists only after successful Worker activation.
concepts.definition: The Worker's closed output to its declared consumer, the Executive in the coordinated branch. Its five construction-availability values refine the predicate 'a candidate is available': candidate_ready, refused, incomplete, re_entry_requested(authority), and re_entry_requested(basis). They are carriers, not new dispositions, assessment or acceptance.

grounding.quote:
A work result is the Worker's closed output to its declared consumer; in
the coordinated branch that consumer is the Executive. It exists only after
a successful Worker activation.

concepts.label: Work result

concepts.definition: An activation-level refusal carrying its cause and the core value assigned by REFERENCE_FRAME §5. It returns to assigning authority or the declared result carrier and creates neither a Worker activation nor a Worker result.

grounding.quote:
An `activation_refusal`, with the cause and
core value that
[REFERENCE_FRAME §5](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#5-method-functions) gives it,
returns to the assigning authority or declared result carrier and creates
neither a Worker activation nor a Worker result.

concepts.label: Activation refusal

concepts.definition: The exact subject identity required by transition evidence and traceability. Generic method qualification requires the construction result to be frozen before material reference exposure; elsewhere an immutable identity or equivalent exact-subject relation stabilises the subject sufficiently for the assessment. The profile introduces no lifecycle state named frozen.

grounding.quote:
An exact candidate is the subject identity that the transition evidence of
ACTIVATION §7 and the traceability of EVALUATION §3 require.

concepts.label: Exact candidate

concepts.definition: The Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis projects existing owner decisions and records the configuration's material sources. A baseline-adoption projection consumes that basis and, where it adopts the profile, records selected mapping, exact outcome, actor envelopes, evidence coordinates and revision conditions in addition to the Product binding; it is neither a second basis nor a source of authority.

grounding.quote:
A baseline-adoption projection consumes the Product-owned Project
Reference-Frame Basis of PRODUCT_DEFINITION §7. Where that basis adopts
this profile, the projection records the selected profile mapping, exact
outcome, actor envelopes, evidence coordinates and revision conditions
needed in addition to the Product binding (§16). It is not a second
frame-basis definition and mints none of the authority it projects

concepts.label: Product basis and baseline-adoption projection

concepts.definition: A bounded attention procedure over U, every known material evaluation not closed on the current basis, and finite dependency-ready activation subsets M. It tracks the frontier and closed-result ledger, not every evaluator's undocumented working context.

grounding.quote:
U0 = every known material evaluation not closed on the current basis

while U is non-empty:
  select a finite dependency-ready subset M that fits the assigned actors
  activate each member of M against the exact outcome and basis

concepts.label: Attention cycle

concepts.definition: Five checks revalidated before activation and disposition: outcome lock, basis lock, Product-role lock, authority lock, and coverage-and-return lock. Their failed cases inherit the owning law's value or move; this profile adds none.

grounding.quote:
Before activation and before disposition, the Executive revalidates five
locks

concepts.label: Drift locks

concepts.definition: The basis of one Product or an explicit directed Product chain records distinct roles for mutable Source Project, current Product Definition, exact candidate checkpoint, Release Cut, Product, Install, Artifact, Development Product, dependent Product and composition edge. Every Development Product role binds one exact underlying Install.

grounding.quote:
A governed outcome may concern one Product or an explicit directed chain of
Products. Its basis records the distinct role of every mutable Source
Project, current Product Definition, exact candidate checkpoint, Release
Cut, Product, Install, Artifact, Development Product, dependent Product and
composition edge. Each Development Product role binds one exact underlying
Install identity.

concepts.label: Product-chain basis

concepts.definition: A task-selected configuration assigning construction to Worker/Writer, required assessment to Reviewer, and coordination across tasks and granted disposition to Executive. It fits work where bounded change and delivery across successive tasks need separate attention; it is not the method's default or a role inventory all work requires.

grounding.quote:
It is
one configuration, selected where it fits the task, not an inventory of
roles that all work needs.

concepts.label: Executive configuration

concepts.definition: Three distinct structures used by the configuration: authority precedence determines which existing surface may select work, admit configuration, dispose results or require re-entry; temporal and evidence flow carries activation packets and closed results; frame topology records disjointness, overlap, conjunction, translation or composition. Evaluation independence and Reviewer assurance independence are separate activation relations.

grounding.quote:
frame topology records disjointness, overlap, conjunction, translation
   or composition among the evaluations actually used (REFERENCE_FRAME §7),
   while evaluation independence and Reviewer assurance independence stay
   separate activation relations.

concepts.label: Configuration relation structures

concepts.definition: The profile's selected construction strategy: the smallest real runnable path from a supported Product entry to a material outcome through selected composition, established early and widened in bounded increments. The rationale is early end-to-end feedback at the cost of later widening, without claiming superiority over lawful strategies of other configurations.

grounding.quote:
The Executive sequences delivery around a steel thread: the smallest real,
runnable path from a supported Product entry to a material outcome through
the selected composition.

concepts.label: Steel-thread delivery

conditions: Resolved in urn:stdo:bounded-context:reference-frame-evaluation under the selected basis.
concepts.definition: Product family: evaluates whether one exact current Product claim, outcome, boundary and lifecycle govern the subject without downstream reinterpretation, using current Intent, Product, requirements, acceptance meaning and exact coordinates. Product and requirement authority retain meaning and acceptance; output is bounded evaluation and evidence only. Immediate falsifier: design, code, tests, predecessor behaviour or local convention changes Product meaning or substitutes another Product subject.

grounding.quote: Product and requirement authority keep meaning and acceptance. The frame returns only a bounded evaluation result and evidence.

concepts.label: Product evaluation family

conditions: Resolved in the reference-frame-evaluation bounded context.
concepts.definition: Product Composition family: evaluates an exact directed Product relation preserving source/target roles, Product Definition, Release Cut, Product and Install identities, Development Product role bindings, contracts, authority, lifecycle, evidence boundary and invalidation law. A chain uses bounded edge activations and declared conjunction. Each Product retains meaning; cited authority/contracts own the edge; output is evaluation evidence only. Falsifiers include connectivity or builder convenience creating/changing composition, confusing builder with authored Product, or one node silently redefining another.

grounding.quote: A chain is evaluated through bounded edge activations and a declared conjunction.

concepts.label: Product Composition family

conditions: Resolved in the reference-frame-evaluation bounded context.
concepts.definition: Design family: evaluates whether accepted structural HOW satisfies material constitutional WHAT, closes required design relations and preserves owners across affected topology. Accepted design under Product and requirements owns structure; output may identify satisfaction, contradiction or design re-entry gap, never invent Product truth. Falsifiers: implementation precedent resolves open material design decisions, design creates Product meaning, or material relations/competing structures remain undeclared.

grounding.quote: The frame may identify satisfaction, contradiction or a design re-entry gap; it cannot invent Product truth.

concepts.label: Design family

conditions: Resolved in the reference-frame-evaluation bounded context.
concepts.definition: Design Component family: evaluates one bounded component and direct causal dependency cone against parent contract, internal relations, sibling seams and required outputs. Accepted design owns only its bounded composition decision; parent, sibling, Product, requirement and runtime owners retain theirs. Falsifiers: omitted material far-side seam, absorbed sibling/parent decision, or local closure with unresolved direct composition.

grounding.quote: The accepted design boundary owns only its bounded composition decision. Parent, sibling, Product, requirement and runtime owners keep their relations.

concepts.label: Design Component family

conditions: Resolved in the reference-frame-evaluation bounded context.
concepts.definition: Public Boundary family: evaluates a supported public entry/exit's assigned validation, selection, transport, refusal and projection while preserving interior owners. Product, interface, identity, security and accepted design define the boundary. Output is closed boundary evaluation or refusal, without recreating interior semantics. Falsifiers: interpreting owner meaning, sequencing hidden domain decisions, presenting interior carriers as Product truth, or admitting unsupported paths.

grounding.quote: The frame evaluates the boundary result or refusal and returns only its closed evaluation; it does not recreate interior semantics.

concepts.label: Public Boundary family

conditions: Resolved in the reference-frame-evaluation bounded context.
concepts.definition: Entity family: evaluates a semantic, artifact or runtime entity's exact identity, kind, lifecycle, owner, representation and applicable effect regime under Product, domain, identity, requirement and accepted-design authority. Output is identity- and lifecycle-bound evaluation. Falsifiers: filename, wrapper, ticket, object shape, cache or process substitutes for stable identity, or distinct lifecycle coordinates collapse.

grounding.quote: The frame returns an identity- and lifecycle-bound evaluation.

concepts.label: Entity family

conditions: Resolved in the reference-frame-evaluation bounded context.
concepts.definition: Operator family: evaluates a material operation as an irreducible declared relation over admitted domain, inputs, outputs, refusals, algebra, effects and lawful compositions. Product, requirements, accepted ontology/design and named operation owner define it; evaluation creates no additional executable plan. Falsifiers: implementation label asserted as semantic atom, orchestration hiding the operator, or generic mechanics rebuilt as domain law.

grounding.quote: The frame evaluates it without creating another executable plan.

concepts.label: Operator family

conditions: Resolved in the reference-frame-evaluation bounded context.
concepts.definition: Owner family: evaluates preservation of a semantic/authority relation's owner, role kind, subject, scope, basis, lifecycle, refusal invariants and permitted delegation. The existing named authority owns the relation; this frame only evaluates authority congruence. Falsifiers: another surface recreates judgment, authorship implies authority transfer, or proxy, foundation, frame or actor widens a grant.

grounding.quote: The frame may evaluate authority congruence only.

concepts.label: Owner family

conditions: Resolved in the reference-frame-evaluation bounded context.
concepts.definition: Effect family: evaluates an action's pure, observational, artifact or runtime effect regime, including material commit, failure, retry, recovery, compensation, admission and projection law. Applicable Product, requirement, design, artifact, runtime and admission owners retain decisions; output is effect-bound result/evidence. Falsifiers: collapsed regimes, mutation bypassing owner, compensation treated as semantic rollback, or a read becoming rival writable truth.

grounding.quote: The frame returns an effect-bound result and evidence.

concepts.label: Effect family

conditions: Resolved in the reference-frame-evaluation bounded context.
concepts.definition: Reuse/Foundation family: evaluates normalisation and comparison of a material generic capability/dependency against credible lawful foundations, preserving irreducible local remainder and authority-bearing role. Design-profile selection law and existing trade-off owner govern; semantic authority cannot move to a foundation. Falsifiers: incumbent/local code wins without bounded comparison, richer lawful foundation is reproduced, unknowns receive favourable scores, or reuse acquires owner authority.

grounding.quote: The frame cannot move semantic authority to a foundation.

concepts.label: Reuse/Foundation family

conditions: Resolved in the reference-frame-evaluation bounded context.
concepts.definition: Install family: evaluates exact Product, release, artifact, dependency set, configuration and callable entry through admitted installed coordinates, independent of mutable source convenience. Product, identity, release, dependency, packaging and accepted design define the subject; output is installed identity, reachability and refusal evidence. Falsifiers: source imports, ambient resolution, registries, fixtures, rebuilt artifacts or moving workspace replace the claimed installed subject.

grounding.quote: The frame returns installed identity, reachability and refusal evidence.

concepts.label: Install family

conditions: Resolved in the reference-frame-evaluation bounded context.
concepts.definition: Proof family: evaluates one exact claim's congruent subject, basis, path, population, oracle, evidence, falsifier, residual boundary and invalidation law. Claim owner defines meaning; testing, assurance, review, Product and release owners define evaluation/acceptance. Output is evidence and closed evaluation, never Product meaning or disposition. Falsifiers: harness recreates meaning, evidence targets another subject/path, count or aggregate green replaces claim, or proof tooling mutates subject undetectably.

grounding.quote: The frame returns evidence and a closed evaluation result, not Product meaning or disposition.

concepts.label: Proof family

concepts.definition: Coverage is the union of admissible observations contributed by activated frames. A composite claim takes its declared conjunction's result. Every material cross-frame seam is a mandatory result or required coverage, preserving or lawfully translating exact identity, coordinate, basis, carried value/evidence, lifecycle scope, authority and provenance.

grounding.quote:
Coverage records the union of admissible observations the activated frames
contribute. A composite claim takes the value of its declared conjunction

concepts.label: Coverage and conjunction

concepts.definition: Eight bounded coordinated-branch projections: Worker activation, activation refusal, work result, Reviewer activation, review result, specialist activation, specialist result, and disposition/checkpoint. They carry exact material coordinates and closed results through declared producer-consumer relations.

grounding.quote: The coordinated branch uses the following bounded projections.

concepts.label: Handoff projections

concepts.definition: A project-defined allocation of frames, names, overlaps, sequences and actor bindings admitted by existing Product, requirement, Goals or accepted-design authority. It is assessed against its task, dependencies, actor limits, authority and required assurance rather than similarity to this profile.

grounding.quote:
A project may define different frames, names, overlaps, sequences and actor
bindings.

concepts.label: Project-defined configuration

conditions: Instance premises apply where the executive configuration is selected.

grounding.quote:
Its instance premises hold where
the executive configuration is selected; they are adopted with it and do
not follow from the foundations (P1, P6):

constraints.statement: The table imports F1 frames/context, F2 transitions/steps/configuration, F3 results/combination, F4 work-state/resumption/reuse, F5 proportionality/cost, F6 claims/evidence/assessment/acceptance, F15 lineage objects and F13 work carriers. Imported consequences remain owned by their originating rules, never profile choices. P0 is recovered; P1, P2, P3, P4a and P6 are independent; P4b derives from P0 and P2 with non-reacquirability of step-produced facts; P5 derives from P0 and P6 with the open-world premise. Adopted instance premises are I1 bounded tasks under one outcome with separate change/delivery attention, I2 existing project authority holds every applied decision grant, and I3 fallible finite-context actors, possibly probabilistic constructors. Owning clauses control conflicts; inclusion in a cut makes the profile available, not adopted. Names bind only allocated responsibilities. Profile choices must not be presented as foundational consequences. Consumers apply owning rules without additional decisions. The table traces the lead and §§1–22; ASSURANCE-owned terms, this trace and §23 dispositions add no rule. It cites pillars 1–9, not pillar 10, and is new with no rc.2 row.
constraints.uncertainty: The source reports the premises' standing and dependencies; the referenced foundations are not supplied for independent reconstruction.

conditions: One sufficient frame covers the task.

grounding.quote: using this profile adds no review, ticket, diagram recreation or owner ceremony to such a task.

Direct
Worker engagement keeps the same sufficient intake, work-result algebra,
closure conditions and owner boundaries without inserting an Executive
appointment, or a review that no applicable condition requires

constraints.statement: Direct Worker/Writer entry applies with admission, carrier and result recording and adds no unrequired review, ticket, diagram recreation, owner ceremony or Executive appointment. It retains the coordinated route's intake, territory, obligations, evidence, stop conditions, declared consumer, result algebra, closure conditions and owner boundaries. The steps of §12 describe the coordinated branch, not a universal sequence.

conditions: Claiming profile qualification, adoption or work-item closure.

grounding.quote: the profile is qualified only for the revisions, envelopes, branches and populations actually evaluated
every requirement of this profile as an exact application of an owning relation or a condition for claiming adoption

constraints.statement: Qualification extends only to actually evaluated revisions, envelopes, branches and populations. Mechanical document checks and source-linked Reviewer evaluation must be bound together without claiming either as the other; structure proves no semantic truth. A closed indeterminate result or review event discharges no unresolved obligation and indeterminate never maps to satisfied. Work-item closure applies to the selected branch only. The reported twenty-six trial obligations and twenty-four application conditions apply traced/imported consequences and add no rules. Every profile requirement is an application of an owning relation or a condition for claiming adoption.
constraints.uncertainty: The trial obligations, application conditions and imported closure law are referenced but not enumerated in the supplied sections.

grounding.quote:
That evidence does not become method
authority, and it imports none of the originating consumer's architecture,
names, actors, topology, runtime, artifacts or work stages into this
generic profile

constraints.statement: Delivery practice and observed failure may inform selection, qualification and revision but confer no method authority or imported consumer architecture, names, actors, topology, runtime, artifacts or work stages. Inability to perceive a known violation evidences a missing, misactivated, oversized or capability-incompatible frame. Repeated resets, long repair loops, moving review subjects, proof masking and duplicated authority signal possible defects of declaration, activation, capability, basis or authority and justify re-evaluation without establishing a verdict or universal architecture. Repeated Product drift is read similarly: useful implementation, specialisation, scenario, dependency, installed builder or downstream Product does not become the authored Product through shared visibility or delivery-chain participation.
constraints.uncertainty: Signals indicate possible defects rather than identifying one definite cause.

conditions: The profile's engagement relation is used.

grounding.quote: The engagement relation of this profile requires (P0, P6):

constraints.statement: One bounded authority selects active work and finite evaluation frames. Worker constructs one exact candidate, self-reviews, reports and stops. Where independent assessment is required, a separately activated Reviewer acquires sufficient exact live authority, subject and evidence, reuses valid computed facts and supplies its own judgment. An activated Reviewer returns evidence-bound severity and technical implications without becoming a second implementation loop. Where coordination is required, Executive assigns priority and adjudicates the current Product mandate within an existing bounded grant.

conditions: A member, file, component or lens is claimed as a frame.

grounding.quote:
A method member,
file, component or lens becomes a frame only when its evaluation, basis,
material manifold, authority, evidence, result algebra and capability
envelope are declared

constraints.statement: Frame status requires declaration of evaluation, basis, material manifold, authority, evidence, result algebra and capability envelope; a label or carrier alone is insufficient.

grounding.quote:
It is not a
universal semantic owner, controller, manager service or runtime executive
observer

It acquires no admission, publication, acceptance or continuation
authority

It does not implement the repair,
assign priority, apply disposition or activate the next frame

constraints.statement: Executive is no universal semantic owner, controller, manager service or runtime observer. Worker gains no admission, publication, acceptance or continuation authority. Reviewer implements no repair, assigns no priority, applies no disposition and activates no next frame. Role labels create no grants.

conditions: Technical triage is returned.

grounding.quote:
Missing causal or repair evidence stays explicit. Where the missing
relation can change the evaluation, the Reviewer returns `indeterminate` or
`out_of_frame` pressure (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results); it does not invent precision and
does not send work sideways to the Worker

constraints.statement: Every triage field is bounded by admissible evidence and actor capability. Missing cause or repair evidence remains explicit; a missing relation capable of changing evaluation yields indeterminate or out_of_frame pressure, not invented precision or sideways work dispatch. Likely repair complexity and regression risk may be assessed without becoming repair owner.

grounding.quote:
This profile imposes no
universal numeric scale. Severity, priority, the frame result
(FOUNDATIONS §4 Results) and the current-boundary effect are four distinct
values.

A hard stop or a falsified mandatory claim cannot be
waived by lowering priority. An observation outside the exact claim
boundary cannot open another review round because it carries a severe
label

constraints.statement: The Product basis binds severity/priority scales, boundary cutoff and its non-waivable hard stops. ACTIVATION owns hard-stop meaning and typical, non-closed classes; no priority, cutoff, risk appetite or decision waives a hard stop. No universal numeric scale is imposed. Severity, priority, frame result and boundary effect remain four values even if policy maps them; none alone decides promotion blocking. A recorded blocks effect requires an EVALUATION §5 condition. The decision reaches the core only through the one existing disposition; only disposition decides acceptance. Lowering priority waives neither a hard stop nor a falsified mandatory claim. An outside-claim observation cannot reopen review solely through severity. EVALUATION §4 owns result-specific triage projection and consumption.
constraints.uncertainty: The full imported blocking conditions and result-specific projection are not supplied.

conditions: Construction-availability mapping applies only after lawful activation.

grounding.quote: - `candidate_ready` (`satisfied`):

The work
  result is never read as `indeterminate`, as ACTIVATION §3 states

constraints.statement: ACTIVATION §3 owns grounds and the total, exclusive map of each of five values to exactly one core value. candidate_ready maps to satisfied for availability, binds exact candidate/transition evidence and prompts a review-requirement decision, never accept. refused maps to falsified and names its prohibiting counterexample; Executive verifies basis and applies existing authority. incomplete maps to falsified: residuals/stop basis distinguish each unperformed evaluation with no result, each performed undecidable evaluation retaining its own indeterminate, and whether bounded execution ended first; the availability result itself is not indeterminate and reactivation requires current permission. re_entry_requested(authority) maps to out_of_frame and returns to the named decision owner. re_entry_requested(basis) maps to invalid_basis and requires basis-lock revalidation before any further activation. Known activation-time capability, authority, stale/ambiguous-basis or topology mismatch is activation_refusal with cause, never a synthetic Worker result. The profile supplies no new grounds or execution/disposition ownership.
constraints.uncertainty: Imported grounds are not fully reproduced; the shown mappings do not supply missing admission predicates.

conditions: A result is handed off or reused.

grounding.quote:
The result references the current computed classification, supporting
evidence, residual judgments and original rulings through their existing
carriers. It does not reconstruct unchanged C/J/O at each handoff.

constraints.statement: Reference computed classification, evidence, residual judgments and original rulings through existing carriers without reconstructing unchanged C/J/O at each handoff. Consumer checks applicability and concrete invalidators. Changed evidence revises only affected results, preserving originals and supported surviving claims.
constraints.uncertainty: The excerpt does not independently expand the C/J/O notation.

conditions: Acting as Executive over one governed outcome.

grounding.quote:
The Executive is the frame for three inseparable duties over one governed
outcome

constraints.statement: Attention management retains exact outcome/basis, Product-role map, evaluation inventory, dependencies, unresolved frontier, actor envelopes, current mandate, triage policy and residual boundary, selecting the smallest dependency-ready activation set sufficient for the next decision within finite envelopes. Evaluation orchestration activates capable Workers, Reviewers or specialists on exact subjects/bases and consumes only closed results or declared translations. Authorised action selection assigns priority and boundary effect, applies existing disposition and issues only the next already-authorised activation/action. Executive neither contains the entire workspace nor performs every evaluation, and acquires no Product meaning, implementation, mutation, acceptance, publication or other operation authority from its role; material effects remain owned by the actor with the exact operation grant.

conditions: The executive configuration is selected.
An actor occupies the Executive frame.

grounding.quote:
An actor occupying the Executive frame modifies no candidate, Product or
worktree bytes and performs no implementation effect.

constraints.statement: Executive makes no candidate, Product or worktree-byte change and no implementation effect. Tool/filesystem access and small, test-only, reversible or obvious edits are no exceptions; even a grant spanning construction, status and checkpoint does not lift the prohibition. Mutation needs a separately activated Worker/Writer relation with exact operation grant, subject and write territory. A same-actor transition must be explicit and recorded in the existing carrier before the effect, for which the actor is no longer Executive. Later recording or delegation cannot authorise an Executive edit retroactively.

conditions: U contains known material evaluations not closed on the current basis.

grounding.quote: keep assurance-independent evaluations free of unclosed peer results

stop only when every mandatory evaluation is closed, or governing authority
has explicitly retained every remaining residual consistently with the claim

constraints.statement: Select finite dependency-ready M fitting actors, activate on exact outcome/basis, isolate assurance-independent evaluations from unclosed peer results, and await decision-relevant input when no other authorised decision is ready. Record every closed result, technical triage, residual and invalidation condition; apply only declared conjunctions/translations; assign priority/effect only under the current mandate; invalidate affected results when subject/basis changes; update U from coverage, dependencies, conflicts and discovered materiality. Stop only when all mandatory evaluations close or governing authority explicitly retains every remaining residual consistently with the claim. Severity evidence, priority, boundary effect, disposition and next action remain separate ledger entries despite policy mappings. Every result returns by explicit relation to Executive, conjunction or another frame with source routes, not hidden reasoning; no result activates a frame or authorises continuation by itself.
constraints.uncertainty: This records source procedure as data and does not execute it.

exceptions: Unavailable or unreliable notification, or an actual supervision obligation requiring observation, invokes declared bounded fallback observation.

grounding.quote: Executive attention is event-driven by default.

Silence proves neither progress nor
failure.

constraints.statement: Default re-entry triggers are a decision-relevant closed result, material exception/changed basis, owner request, or declared deadline/checkpoint. While Workers exercise bounded grants and no authorised decision is ready, wait without repeated unfinished-work inspection, unchanged-judgment replay or purposeless status requests. Retain frontier, return conditions and valid support; refresh affected support on material observation and revalidate locks before activation/disposition. Waiting waives no workspace verification, evidence validity, required independent assessment, closed-result consumption, authority or closure duty. Fallback declares purpose, cadence/checkpoint, evidence target and stop/escalation condition. Investigate genuine blockers/material risks and intervene where required within grants; unknown status alone does not establish stalling. Repeated no-progress observations or returns without new decision-relevant evidence require bounded frame/grant/dependency/evidence-gap reassessment and authorised decision, not continued polling or same repair on unchanged basis. Reduced churn permits no lower assurance or capability and creates no universal cost, budget or accounting gate.

conditions: Before every activation and disposition.

grounding.quote: | basis lock | the subject, authority, dependency, configuration, topology, evidence, time and candidate coordinates are exact and current |

constraints.statement: Outcome lock requires unchanged selected Goal, Product outcome, boundary, lawful re-entry class, current MVP/release mandate and triage policy. Basis lock requires exact current subject, authority, dependency, configuration, topology, evidence, time and candidate coordinates. Product-role lock preserves distinct Source Project, Product Definition, Release Cut, Product, Install, Artifact and dependent Product identities, with every Development Product role bound to its exact Install. Authority lock requires unchanged semantic, evaluation, operation, decision, acceptance and publication owners/grants. Coverage-and-return lock requires every material evaluation/interaction closed or explicit residual and every consumed result received through its declared return relation.

conditions: A lock fails.

grounding.quote: | stale basis of a held result, before disposition | for the disposition's conjunction the component has no applicable closed result: a gap, never relabelled `invalid_basis` and never counted as returned

constraints.statement: Changed Product meaning yields re_enter to its owner. Stale/substituted basis before activation yields activation_refusal(basis), invalid_basis. Evaluation performed on stale/substituted basis has its own invalid_basis result or is reactivated on current basis. A held result stale before disposition instead contributes a gap with no applicable closed result, never relabelled invalid_basis or counted returned. Missing material scope yields out_of_frame under admission law at activation or the evaluation ground of undeclared material relation/capability. Missing operation authority refuses activation with activation_refusal(authority), or refuses the effect. Unresolved mandatory conflict survives every join and makes conjunction non-satisfied. Executive repairs none by enlarging its own frame; no additional profile outcome is invented.
constraints.uncertainty: Owner-specific grounds beyond the shown cases remain imported.

grounding.quote:
Directory nesting, shared code,
shared actors, source imports, tool reachability, matching labels or equal
outputs create no Product identity, composition edge or authority transfer

A repair advances the workspace, creates a new
candidate and invalidates the affected results.

constraints.statement: Every composition edge names source/target roles, governing authority/contracts, lifecycle, evidence boundary, refusal and invalidation. An installed Product may lawfully build its successor or another Product while remaining distinct from mutable Source Project and authored Product. Nesting, shared code/actors, imports, reachability, labels or equal outputs establish no identity, edge or authority transfer. Exact basis does not make Source Project immutable: granted Worker mutation may accumulate within exact subject/territory, while Reviewer assesses an exact produced checkpoint. Repair creates a new candidate and invalidates affected results. Released Product, Release Cut and exact Install retain their own lifecycle immutability without imposing it on the successor's Source Project.

grounding.quote:
distinct relation structures and the rule that they may be aligned where
the subject warrants it but are never one hierarchy.

The overlap collapses
neither evaluation nor authority

constraints.statement: RF-009's structures may align where warranted but never become one hierarchy; this configuration adds or merges none of the other structures. Executive, Worker and Reviewer may overlap on method basis, outcome, checkpoint, affected relations, candidate, evidence and residuals while retaining separate evaluations and authority. Executive evaluates activation/priority/effect/disposition; Worker evaluates and performs construction; Reviewer evaluates exact claims and supplies activated triage. The active-evaluation notation combines engagement frame, material specialist set, exact subject/basis and capable actor into one activated evaluation; it requires no Cartesian-product schema or universal runtime.
constraints.uncertainty: RF-009's full structure list is not supplied.

conditions: The configuration is selected where its task fit holds.

grounding.quote:
Where it is selected, every grant, duty, limit and prohibition this
profile places on its frames is in force without exception

A
compact result carries every blocker material to delivery

constraints.statement: Selection makes all profile grants, duties, limits and prohibitions effective without exception; no operation grant lifts them. Allocation requires explanation of fit, resources and failures. Every actor has finite attention/context: Worker holds one causal cone, Reviewer one exact claim/evidence, Executive outcome/frontier/closed-result ledger, not evaluator working context or whole workspace. Product basis records concrete capability envelopes; selected execution binding sets time, spend and other limits, which must be declared, measured and honoured. Fallible self-review stays construction output, required assessment is independent, Executive does not change its decision subject, stale/wrong-subject results require locks, activation refusal returns cause without Worker result, and uncertain effects require reconciliation. The coordinator acquires missing decision inputs through its frame inputs or another bounded evaluation. Every delivery-material blocker must survive compaction in work residuals/stop basis/effect values, review findings/counterexamples/residuals, or specialist residuals. The subsection is new with no rc.2 row and explains fit and invariant applicability rather than making this the default.

conditions: An Executive frame is declared or evaluated.

grounding.quote: | capability envelope | enough method, Product, release or MVP, authority, workspace, triage and actor-selection competence to configure, prioritise and dispose the bounded evaluation; implementation expertise may be delegated to specialist frames |
The frame adds no `authorize` or `no_action` disposition.

constraints.statement: Evaluation asks authorised outcome/basis, capable frames/actors, result exactness/currency, and mandate-supported priority/effect/disposition/next action. Subject/basis includes complete selected method cut, exact Goals/Product/requirements/design/work authority, current mandate, workspace/checkpoint, open findings/triage, policy and any proxy grant. Manifold includes outcome, mandate, affected cone, evaluation inventory/configuration, actor envelopes, evidence obligations, returned results/triage, priority/effect, re-entry owners and authorised-continuation boundary. Coordinates identify method, project, outcome, mandate, authority, checkpoint, candidate, evidence, finding, triage policy and actors. Governing invariants are RF-001–RF-017, ACTIVATION intake/execution, design bounded-frame conservation, and applicable identity/carrier/assurance/release law. Evidence includes live authority, frame/specialist results, triage, exact candidate, transition evidence and coverage residuals. Capability covers method, Product, release/MVP, authority, workspace, triage and actor selection; specialist implementation expertise may be delegated. Exclusions include mutation, implementation ownership, silent rewriting of review evidence/severity, unqualified independent-review claims, semantic reconstruction owned elsewhere and disposition outside grant. Result is one core result plus priority/effect and one existing disposition where basis is decidable. Material method, authority, outcome, mandate, triage policy, checkpoint, candidate, evidence, finding, capability or topology change invalidates. Candidate dispositions remain exactly accept/local_repair/re_enter/reject; activate remains the imported function. No authorize/no_action disposition is added. Unreliable assessment requires capable re-evaluation or retained uncertainty, never silent rewriting.
constraints.uncertainty: Imported invariant contents and design conservation laws remain external.

conditions: Using this profile's steel-thread strategy.
exceptions: Where a thread already exists, extend or revalidate the affected thread.
An early focused user probe remains appropriate when it decides material outcome uncertainty.

grounding.quote:
Each passing thread establishes only the relations and
conditions actually exercised; untested branches, interaction combinations,
and refusal and recovery paths keep their material proof obligations.

constraints.statement: Establish the real runnable thread early and widen boundedly, choosing increments by consequential uncertainty, dependency/interface reach and failure impact. Early end-to-end/integration evidence prunes incompatible choices, settles exercised interfaces and preserves working composition while focusing unresolved obligations. Passing covers only exercised relations/conditions; untested branches, combinations and refusal/recovery retain proof duties. Material counterevidence reopens settled construction. During construction use focused deterministic regression, targeted judgment probes and unit evidence for module laws. Schedule substantial resource-intensive user-acceptance near release or when a bounded capability can qualify. Testing frames retain distinct claims and govern scenarios, independence and repetitions. Reuse qualified results only while exact subject/basis remain valid and rerun affected assurance after invalidation. Sequence remains under existing mandate and construction activation requires existing operation grants.

conditions: A Worker frame is activated.

grounding.quote: | evaluation family | Can the exact authorised outcome be constructed through the smallest coherent causal cone while preserving every affected governing relation and disposing of competing paths? |

Read scope follows the complete causal cone and may exceed write territory
within the declared access grant.

constraints.statement: Worker evaluates construction of the exact authorised outcome through the smallest coherent causal cone preserving all affected governing relations and disposing competing paths. Basis is sufficient intake and accepted design-to-execution basis where applicable. Manifold includes affected entities, lifecycles, transformations, authorities, capabilities, algorithms, inputs/outputs, dependencies, seams, failure boundaries and proof duties. Coordinates identify activation, source checkpoint, workspace, inputs, dependencies, configuration, actor envelope, outputs, candidate and evidence. All material selected method/project relations govern; ACTIVATION owns construction/self-review. Authority is inherited bounded construction/transformation and self-review only, with exact subject/territory for mutation; no admission, publication, independent acceptance, frame-set revision or inferred next action. Evidence includes live implementation, tests and source, analysis, artifacts, claimed installed/operational behaviour, reconstruction, mutations and transitions. Capability covers method/domain/implementation/tool/access/finite context. Exclusions: upstream semantic change, unauthorised cone expansion, self-acceptance, hidden competing paths and continuation after return. Exactly one availability work result is returned while each performed evaluation keeps its own core result. Material intake, basis, checkpoint, dependency, configuration, capability or topology change invalidates. Green tests evidence only exercised production/test semantics. Missing, ambiguous or outside-territory mutation grants refuse the effect. Read scope follows the complete causal cone within access grants, potentially beyond write territory; narrow writes cannot excuse omitting material producers, consumers or owners. Outside-territory repair returns to its owner; understanding grants no cross-boundary effect.

conditions: Reviewer evaluation is activated.

grounding.quote: | authority | bounded evaluation only; review access yields no construction, transformation, admission, publication, mutation, decision, disposition or next-activation authority |

constraints.statement: Reviewer evaluates exact subject/basis and applicable method/project satisfaction without competing authority, proof masking or unevaluated composition, supplying supported finding implications. Basis binds candidate, claim, authority, scope/exclusions, population, severity scale, carrier and independence. Manifold covers claimed relations, producers/consumers, authority seams, competing paths, claimed failure/recovery/installed/reconstruction surfaces, test/fixture semantics, historical counterexamples and supportable triage. Coordinates bind candidate, source basis, authority revision, configuration, dependency, population, severity scale, installed subject, review time and Reviewer. RF-001–RF-017, execution, independence/traceability, assurance/freeze and applicable Product/design/identity/release law govern. Evidence is independently acquired live authority, implementation, tests, artifacts, history, operational evidence, mutations, replay/reconstruction and reproduced material observations. Capability covers method, domain, implementation, assurance, triage, tools, access, context, counterexample search and independence. Authority is bounded evaluation only; exclusions include editing/repair, priority, disposition, next action, replacing inspection with Worker summary, assurance-owned semantic reconstruction, unbound-evidence flattening and silent scope expansion. Return one core result with findings, counterexamples, triage and sufficient residuals. Material candidate, authority, basis, population, scale, dependency, configuration, scope or independence change invalidates. TICKETS plus governing basis determine when review is required; EVALUATION determines independence, traceability, assurance boundary and freeze. No universal review round, new independence test, second verdict or disposition family is created.
constraints.uncertainty: Full imported independence and assurance tests are not supplied.

conditions: A finding, retained guard or acceptance predicate is assessed.

grounding.quote:
Each finding binds a violated property, a supported entry or state, the
governing operating or threat model and a credible causal path.

constraints.statement: Unsupported cause, blast radius, workaround or repair risk remains uncertainty rather than fabricated complete triage. Test code, fixtures, mutations, environment and interpretation enter review whenever they can change the proof claim; passing does not replace semantic review. Findings bind violated property, supported entry/state, governing operating/threat model and credible causal path; retained guards and acceptance predicates meet the same conditions. Excluded threats alone establish no retention claim; widening a threat model re-enters its owner. Internal location alone proves no trust and hypothetical hostility alone proves no applicability. Retain required actual untrusted-input, mutable-state, authority and effect checks. Suggested repairs become obligations only through their proper owner.

conditions: An adopting project activates a family instance.

grounding.quote:
Each
row is an evaluation archetype, not a complete frame declaration
The families are non-hierarchical and may overlap

constraints.statement: Every activated instance binds exact subject, basis, manifold, coordinates, invariants, authority, evidence, exclusions, result algebra, capability envelope, dependencies and invalidation conditions. Family labels resolve within REFERENCE_FRAME-owned urn:stdo:bounded-context:reference-frame-evaluation under the selected basis; same spelling does not identify them with Product, authority, domain or runtime concepts. Every material cross-context seam needs an explicit relation. Families are non-hierarchical and may overlap: Product topology does not outrank Design, Owner breadth grants no authority over Entity/Operator, and Proof gains no Reviewer, acceptance or disposition authority. Existing authority controls. Each family's stated permitted outputs and immediate falsifiers constrain its evaluation.

conditions: For each governed outcome, for every family.

grounding.quote:
For each governed outcome the known evaluation inventory (REFERENCE_FRAME
§8) disposes every family as one of

constraints.statement: The inventory assigns every family one of: material and instantiated by one or more exact declarations or authoritative acquisition paths; evidenced non-material for the exact outcome by capable authority; or explicit uncovered, conditional, conflicted or out_of_frame residual. Absence of a named file, component, runtime object or actor proves no non-materiality. Adoption requires neither twelve components nor twelve active frames per task.

conditions: A generic frame is recursively refined.

grounding.quote:
Refinement opens only for a material
distinction needed to close the parent evaluation.

constraints.statement: Each child records parent contract, purpose, material entities, identity/lifecycle relations, semantic owners, direct sibling seams, applicable invariants and prohibited competing paths. Refinement requires a material distinction needed to close the parent evaluation and is a frame dependency, not organisational/runtime hierarchy.

conditions: A composite includes a material cross-frame seam.

grounding.quote: A composite with any of these cases is never `satisfied`

constraints.statement: A planned seam assessment not evaluated or with only stale/wrong-subject/wrong-basis result is a gap with no value, not a returned result. A material seam with no planned assessment is uncovered coverage, also a gap with no value. Evaluated non-preservation/non-lawful translation yields the seam's falsified result or the imported cause-specific refused-translation outcome/core value. Undecidable evidence yields indeterminate; a needed undeclared translation/relation yields out_of_frame; evaluation performed on stale, advanced, ambiguous or mismatched basis yields its own returned invalid_basis. Any such case prevents satisfied. Record every gap by kind; report the non-satisfied value under FOUNDATIONS conjunction and the adopting project's declared rule when multiple values occur. This profile selects no dominant frame.
constraints.uncertainty: The imported combination rule and refused-translation cause map are not fully supplied.

conditions: The specialist set is adopted.

grounding.quote:
Neither adds a thirteenth family, a fifth
testing type, a role or a universal activation gate

constraints.statement: ASSURANCE §7 testing frames supply claim-congruent evidence to one or more Proof evaluations; user-acceptance, end-to-end, integration and unit results retain distinct claims/coordinates, with no Proof testing hierarchy or aggregate-green frame. ASSURANCE §13 end-to-end interface integration relates Public Boundary, Design, Operator, Owner and Proof to integration, end-to-end and user-acceptance frames. Its computational whole-path evaluation composes selected interface claims with Operator, Owner, Reuse/Foundation and Proof. Neither adds a thirteenth family, fifth testing type, role or universal activation gate.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced testing and interface-frame definitions remain external.

conditions: Selecting the governed outcome and work authority.

grounding.quote:
Goals, Product, requirements, accepted design, a ticket, release law or an
admitted bounded proxy selects the outcome and the work authority under its
existing owner. The Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis
(PRODUCT_DEFINITION §7) projects that decision

constraints.statement: Goals, Product, requirements, accepted design, ticket, release law or admitted bounded proxy selects outcome and work authority under its existing owner. The Product-owned basis projects this decision rather than creating its authority.

conditions: The coordinated branch activates a Worker.

grounding.quote:
If activation detects a known capability, authority, subject, basis or
topology mismatch, it returns `activation_refusal` directly to the
Executive

constraints.statement: Executive applies imported activate to sufficient execution intake. Packet identifies complete selected method/project authority, exact outcome/checkpoint, affected causal relations/invariants, selected computational relations/specialists, authority/capability envelope, evidence/qualification duties, exclusions/competing paths, stop/re-entry conditions and exact already-authorised bounded action. Where testing is required it includes testing claims, subjects, topology, material combination populations, ordinary paths, oracles and forbidden-path exclusions. Where mutation is authorised it includes exact inherited grant, subject and territory. Known capability, authority, subject, basis or topology mismatch returns refusal directly to Executive with cause/imported core value; no Worker is active, no Worker evaluation occurs and no Worker result may be manufactured.
constraints.uncertainty: Packet and activation law are imported; this lists only supplied requirements.

conditions: A Worker activation has lawfully occurred.
exceptions: Direct work sends its result to its declared consumer rather than requiring an Executive.

grounding.quote:
Every coordinated Worker activation ends in one closed work result sent to
the Executive; direct work uses its declared result consumer

constraints.statement: Every coordinated activation ends in exactly one closed result to Executive. Explanatory payloads are candidate_ready(exact_subject, transition_evidence, residuals), refused(reason, authority, evidence), incomplete(residuals, evidence, stop_basis), or re_entry_requested(owner, material_relation, evidence). The re-entry material relation distinguishes authority from basis as part of the value, preserving five semantic values despite four displayed constructor forms. The notation mandates no schema; total single-core mapping applies only after lawful activation. Worker neither routes directly to an implicitly active Reviewer nor advances after returning; it stops.

conditions: Executive consumes a work result.

grounding.quote:
None of these variants is accepted progress
because work occurred

constraints.statement: For refused, incomplete or re_entry_requested, verify exact basis, apply existing authority, and record applicable disposition or reactivate only with current permission; work occurrence implies no accepted progress. For every variant, completion_unknown or not_effected whose end is unestablished must be reconciled sufficiently for the next dependent action before reactivation, repetition or any dependent action. For candidate_ready, verify exact subject and determine independent-assessment requirements under TICKETS UP-007, required execution assessment, method qualification and additional Product/release/risk/work-contract boundaries permitted by governing basis. EVALUATION owns independence. Aggregate green cannot satisfy the step when required user-acceptance, end-to-end, integration, unit or negative-path results are missing, bound elsewhere or materially contradicted.
constraints.uncertainty: Detailed reconciliation procedure and independent-assessment triggers remain imported.

conditions: Coordinated branch.
Independent review is not required.

grounding.quote:
the
Executive consumes the exact candidate, the Worker's self-review, the
transition evidence and any mandatory specialist results, and applies the
disposition within its decision envelope.

constraints.statement: Consume exact candidate, Worker self-review, transition evidence and all mandatory specialist results; apply disposition within the decision envelope. Self-review remains Worker evidence and is not relabelled independent by disposition.

conditions: Independent review is required.
exceptions: Where qualification freeze is not required, stabilise through the exact-subject relation sufficient for the claim.

grounding.quote: When independent review is required, the Executive activates the Reviewer

constraints.statement: Activate Reviewer with exact candidate/basis; exact claim, composition boundary, population, scope/exclusions; method/project authority; required evidence/ordinary assurance path; required user-acceptance, end-to-end, integration, unit, combinatorial and negative-path results with exact claims/populations; Product severity scale and affected Product claims; capability/independence envelope; invalidation/stop conditions. Freeze before material reference exposure where EVALUATION §7 requires; otherwise stabilise to EVALUATION §3, ACTIVATION §7 and claim exactness.

conditions: Reviewer returns in the coordinated branch.

grounding.quote:
The
Reviewer returns to the Executive, not to the Worker, and returns no
disposition; a recommendation is evidence only

constraints.statement: Return one closed EVALUATION-shaped evaluation identifying frame/activation, exact subject/basis/claim/scope/exclusions/population, Reviewer/independence, acquired evidence/ordinary path, core result, findings/counterexamples/adjacent observations, each finding's supportable claim/severity/cause/confidence/blast radius/workaround/repair complexity/regression risk/uncertainty, invalidation and applicable re-entry owner. Triage projects under EVALUATION §4 with Reviewer as assessor and Executive as decision owner. Return to Executive, not Worker; no disposition is returned and recommendations remain evidence. No editing, repair direction or continuation authority follows.

conditions: Executive disposes and checkpoints.

grounding.quote:
The disposition
is the acceptance result; neither `candidate_ready` nor a satisfied review
result is acceptance

constraints.statement: Verify every consumed result against current subject/basis, revalidate complete Product view/current mandate, apply declared conjunction, assign priority, record boundary effect and act on exactly one granted disposition: accept, local_repair, re_enter or reject. ACTIVATION retains ownership of dispositions, accepted checkpoint and next already-authorised bounded action. Disposition is the acceptance result; candidate readiness and satisfied review are not acceptance. Repair creates a new candidate and reactivates affected review. Acceptance neither widens Product outcome nor authorises an unselected successor. EVALUATION governs blocking; severity selects neither priority nor block and priority waives no hard stop. Unsupported assessment returns through new/refined activation rather than silent rewriting.

conditions: Determining promotion blocking from consumed findings.

grounding.quote: | an unsupported or materially incomplete technical assessment | a capable evaluation is reactivated, or `indeterminate` is kept; Reviewer evidence is not rewritten |

constraints.statement: Apply the imported EVALUATION §5 projection with Executive as decision owner under current Product mandate. Preserve distinct cases: valid falsification of a mandatory claim governed by a non-waivable stop; any other finding meeting one of four imported conditions, including a finding below cutoff; a finding meeting none; and an observation outside the exact claim. Determine blocking from exact affected claim, current mandate, hard stops and Product cutoff policy. For unsupported or materially incomplete technical assessment, reactivate capable evaluation or retain indeterminate; never rewrite Reviewer evidence.
constraints.uncertainty: The four imported blocking conditions and their complete table outcomes are not present and cannot be reconstructed from the case list.

conditions: Using coordinated-branch projections.
exceptions: Direct engagement substitutes actual granting/result authority for absent Executive and retains the same material intake/result coordinates in its existing carrier.

grounding.quote: | specialist result | evaluator to Executive, a declared conjunction or the exact parent relation | closed result, exact activation and basis, evidence and source routes, residuals, invalidation, no implicit continuation | ACTIVATION §7; the exact specialist owner |

constraints.statement: Worker activation carries exact intake/basis/cone, applicable inherited grant/subject/territory, frames, evidence, exclusions and stop/re-entry conditions. Activation refusal carries attempted frame/subject/basis/actor, capability/authority/basis cause and failed predicate, evidence/reconfiguration pressure, with no Worker result. Work result carries variant, exact subject if any, transition evidence, non-changes, every intended external effect and its completed/not_effected/completion_unknown value, residuals and stop basis. Reviewer activation carries exact subject/claim/composition boundary/population, severity scale, authority, independence and invalidation. Review result carries exact verdict basis, evidence, findings, counterexamples, triage, residuals and invalidation, no priority/disposition. Specialist activation goes from Executive or declared parent to capable evaluator with evaluation/subject/basis, bounded material-relation map, actor envelope, evidence, authority, dependencies, exclusions, consumer and invalidation. Specialist result returns to Executive, declared conjunction or exact parent with closed result, activation/basis, evidence/source routes, residuals/invalidation and no implicit continuation. Disposition/checkpoint returns to existing work authority and any next activation with exact consumed results/triage, mandate, priority/effect, grant, disposition/checkpoint/residuals and next already-authorised action. Imported owners retain each relation. Flattening across candidates, processes, episodes, configurations, populations or bases establishes no relation; needed equality/translation must be declared. Direct substitution creates neither implicit Reviewer activation nor new decision authority.

conditions: Applying coverage to governed work.

grounding.quote:
Executive visibility is not coverage. Every material evaluation still needs
a capable frame, admissible evidence and identified semantic and decision
owners

constraints.statement: Engagement frames organise finite specialist evaluations, not the whole workspace. Executive owns basis/configuration evaluation, challenged on cone/configuration by Worker/Reviewer; uses complete method and current authority, intake/conservation and domain/identity/dependency/implementation/history inputs. Executive configures family/seam coverage while Worker/Reviewer evaluate their exact claims, using declarations/acquisition paths and non-material/residual dispositions. Worker handles realisation/self-review with accepted design, material foundation selection, capability/reuse/implementation/environment/proof inputs and candidate/transition evidence. Worker executes/self-reviews user outcome and installed authoritative path; Reviewer supplies required independence, using respectively user-acceptance and end-to-end frames with Product/UX/identity/acceptance or composition/authority/lifecycle/persistence/recovery/replay/negative-reachability inputs. Integration and unit allocations follow the claim and actual interaction populations or module contract/ontology/carriers/algebra/state/invariant combinations. Worker provides obsolete/rival-path deletion evidence and Reviewer required exact challenge using distinct production-closure and assurance/source-closure graphs plus package/consumer/mutation/sabotage/reconstruction/history inputs. Reviewer handles required exact assessment/triage with live assurance and Product scale. Executive combines exact mandatory results for priority/effect/disposition, checkpoints/continues under existing authority and responds to missing frames/topology with pressure from any frame. Inventory derives from selected method, domain, outcome, history, dependencies and workspace, retaining all unknown, uncovered, conditional, conflicted and authority-excluded residuals. Visibility is not coverage: every material evaluation requires capability, admissible evidence and semantic/decision owners; every material construction, transformation, admission, publication or mutation also requires exact operation owner/grant.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced assurance graphs, conservation laws and inventory law are not fully defined here.

conditions: A material evaluation gap or missing-frame pressure arises.

grounding.quote:
The Executive applies the eight questions of
[REFERENCE_FRAME §10 Diagnostic order](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#diagnostic-order)
in that order, all of them.

constraints.statement: Any active frame may return out_of_frame, indeterminate or invalid_basis, naming missing relation, coordinate, evidence, authority, capability or interaction capable of changing evaluation. Executive applies all eight questions in order: correct declared frame activated; exact subject/basis; actor capability including required independence; admissible evidence available; missing material variable/invariant, asked only after verifying required specialist inputs; missing conjunction/translation; wrong/incomplete evaluation family; need for another frame. Add/revise a frame only when questions 1–7 do not close the gap. The two profile readings add no question. Discovery changing Product, requirements, identity, lifecycle, authority, public contract or accepted design yields re_enter to its existing owner, never enlargement of Executive to repair upstream authority.

grounding.quote:
Two relations stay apart here. Adopting this profile for a Product is
the Product authority's act, recorded in its Project Reference-Frame Basis

constraints.statement: Profile adoption and configuration admission remain separate. Only Product authority adopts, recording the act in its basis; cut inclusion merely provides availability. The smallest existing authority owning each material configuration decision admits it without creating authority. Goals/admitted work authority owns bounded work selection; Product owns Product-wide capability/acceptance meaning; requirements own constitutional behaviour; accepted design owns realisation structure/specialist design frames; identity/release owners retain declared decisions; bounded proxy stays inside its grant. Product basis cites every material configuration source without collapsing them into new local-axiom authority.

conditions: Adopting this baseline.

grounding.quote: A baseline-adoption projection records inside that Product-owned basis

constraints.statement: Record exact complete method, REFERENCE_FRAME and profile identities; admitting authority; governed workspace/Product scope/outcome/basis/time; local Executive/Worker/Reviewer capability envelopes and actor-binding rules; declarations or authoritative acquisition paths and authority-bound non-material or explicit residual dispositions covering each of twelve families; specialist declarations/acquisition paths; local subject/evidence/checkpoint/review-result coordinates; coverage ledger/accepted residual boundary; invalidation/frame-set revision conditions. Where testing evidence is material also record testing declarations, exact Product/module claims, ordinary-path identities, combinatorial populations, scenario matrix, oracles and forbidden-path inventory.

conditions: Defining a project configuration.

grounding.quote:
It keeps every applicable method
relation and identifies how its evaluations cover the claims it makes.

constraints.statement: The defining existing authority records exact method/project basis, known inventory, every frame declaration/capability, semantic/evaluation/material operation/decision authority, intentional overlap/separate activations/required assurance independence, actual conjunction/translation/composition, allocation explanation with material resource limits/failure assumptions, mapping to construction/assessment/disposition/identity/release obligations, coverage/uncertainty and re-entry/invalidation/revision conditions. Preserve every applicable method relation and identify claim coverage. Evaluate against task, dependencies, actor limits, applied authority and required assurance, never labels/topology/distance from baseline. A local axioms document may carry an accepted configuration, but authority derives from cited Goals/Product/requirement/design decisions, not document category.

grounding.quote: Neither choice amends the method's execution law.

constraints.statement: Adding domain/specialist frames, separately activated or assurance-independent coverage, or local evidence coordinates extends the profile. Changing material Executive, Worker, Reviewer, handoff, independence or disposition configuration creates a project-defined profile. Neither amends method execution law. Intentional departure must be recorded as separate method basis or non-conformance, never described as local frame selection.
